channel.title: Invesco · Global Sovereign Study PDFs
channel.description: Annual study landing page: each distinct directly linked annual report PDF, deduplicated. Initial set may contain a single current study; future replaced links create updates.

item.title: A tool for all seasons: the expanding role of ETFs
item.description: ETF adoption among sovereign investors is building steadily, with central banks using them as an efficient route into new asset classes and sovereign wealth funds using them for tactical flexibility and thematic exposure.

item.title: Long-term investing in a more demanding world
item.description: Long-term investing is becoming more valuable but harder to maintain in practice, with governance and liquidity discipline increasingly separating institutions that can stay the course from those that cannot.

item.title: Resilience moves to the centre of portfolio design
item.description: Resilience has become an explicit portfolio design objective, with institutions rethinking diversification, embedding scenario testing into governance, and extending their attention to where assets are held and on what terms.

item.title: AI: investment opportunity and investment tool
item.description: Sovereign investors broadly view AI as a structural shift, with infrastructure and productivity the preferred investment routes and internal deployment expanding within controlled boundaries.
